_comment: Single source of truth for the sales-staff Excel spec. Read by BOTH scripts/generate-sales-template.js (plain JS, require) and the Sprint 4 parser + /api/admin/batches/template (TS, resolveJsonModule). Never redeclare these headers anywhere else. Changing this file is a breaking change for sales staff who already hold the template. v2 (Sprint 9R, Q5 approved 2026-09-21): added รหัสลูกค้า as column A, header พนักงานขาย renamed to Maker. The key sales_rep and table sales_reps are unchanged on purpose. v3 (customer feedback 2026-10-18): removed เลขที่บิล (was column C) — columns after it shifted left one letter; v2 sheets are rejected by the header check.
